title: Unessential
summary: UNESSEN'TIAL, adjective 1. Not essential; not absolutely necessary; not of prime importance. 2. Not constituting the essence. 3. Void of real being; as unessential night. UNESSEN'TIAL, noun Something

inlines.v: UNESSEN'TIAL, adjective 1. Not essential; not absolutely necessary; not of prime importance. 2. Not constituting the essence. 3. Void of real being; as unessential night. UNESSEN'TIAL, noun Something not constituting essence, or not of absolute necessity. Forms are among the unessentials of religion.
